id: AT-AP-28 (approvals carry: summary shapes, standing gates, plugin handoff turns)
note: 0.1.15: (1) measure --compact --copy reads a summary approval line in the handoff's shape: the question after the words ((answer to ...) or (quoting ...)), a used mark followed by words, no once/standing (once); a context-only line is skipped; a line naming an approval without targets or state is listed as not read (re-ask), never dropped (a real summary printed Approvals (checked): none). (2) standing_approval_gates (consent key, default empty): a standing approval whose every gate the setting lists is listed under Approvals (gate allowed by setting); a once one, another gate or a word that is no gate kind still re-asks. (3) plugin handoff turn: the model writes every approval context only (the classifier-safe shape, 0.1.2); publish puts back byte for byte each standing approval the own chain's previous file holds checked and hashed, lists it in approvals_checked and hashes it; a once approval stays context only; measure carries it for the session and its /clear successor, never for another session.
